title: Restriction square for the pinned degree-zero tensor counit
statement: For k:X′→X, opens U⊆X and U′⊆X′, and j:U′→U satisfying j followed by U inclusion = U′ inclusion followed by k, there exists a natural isomorphism t from restriction of (k tensor pullback M)[0] to (j tensor pullback (M|U))[0]. The constructed singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient for the identity of Lk*(M[0]), followed by restriction of the composition-pinned counit for k and then t, equals Lj* of the exact single restriction map followed by the pinned counit for j. This concerns no base-change arrow or direct image. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition].

source.place: Tags 08HY (mate construction), 08FE (open direct image), 08DW (pullback restriction); inherited argument of lem-pc-open-pinned-single-degree-zero-square.

proof.text: Use the constructed target natural isomorphism. Apply the termwise single restriction factor identities to expand the restriction of the tensor single map. Apply the homotopy counit restriction equation at the single complex of M. Counit naturality moves the restriction single comparison past the counit for j. Combine with the exact single restriction factor identity and Functor.map_comp to obtain the displayed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem open_pinned_single_degree_zero_counit_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X)
    (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ k) :
    ∃ t : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0) ⋙
          (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory ≅
        schemeOpenRestriction X U ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j ⋙
          DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U'.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) 0,
      ∀ M : X.Modules,
        let K := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M
        let H := (schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj M
        let s := ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M
        singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient k K ((derivedPullback k).obj K)
            (𝟙 _) U U' j hj ≫
          (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory.map
            (openPinnedSingleDegreeZeroCounit k M) ≫ t.hom.app M =
          (derivedPullback j).map s ≫ openPinnedSingleDegreeZeroCounit j H
